description: This file implements a Windows-specific dialog box interface, including functions to create, display, handle messages, and cancel dialogs with OK and Cancel buttons, using Win32 API. It defines a DialogTemplateBuilder class for constructing dialog templates dynamically.

classes.name: DialogTemplateBuilder
classes.description: A helper class to construct Windows dialog templates dynamically in memory.

methods.name: DialogProcedureCallback
methods.description: Callback function to handle dialog messages, including OK and Cancel commands.

methods.name: ShowOkCancelDialog
methods.description: Creates and shows a modal dialog with OK and Cancel buttons, customizable messages, and callbacks.

methods.name: DialogHandleMessage
methods.description: Processes Windows messages for the current dialog.

methods.name: CancelDialog
methods.description: Programmatically cancels and closes the current dialog.
